jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Social
jobs.description:
**About Landing**

Landing is a nationwide hospitality platform where fully furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests can book from thousands of high-quality apartments in hundreds of cities, for a few nights or a few months. Every unit comes with all the comforts of home and 24/7 local support, whether someone is traveling for work, moving to a new city, or just wants more space than a hotel room. We're headquartered in Birmingham, and this role sits in our San Francisco office.  
  
For apartment owners, we're a fast way to fill units and earn more from them. We handle everything from furnishing to guest turnover, so our partners don't have to do any of the work.

**The role**

Most people have never heard of Landing.

That's our biggest marketing challenge, and our biggest opportunity. When people discover us, they quickly realize there's a better alternative to hotels, Airbnbs, or traditional leases. The problem is most people don't know that an alternative exists. As our first social hire, you'll change that.

You’ll own our social presence from end to end, with paid social as the core of the job. You’ll build it into a growth engine that drives awareness, engagement, and ultimately, booked reservations. Organic social supports this: it's where we find our voice, test ideas, and identify creative worth scaling. This isn't social for the sake of likes or impressions. Success is measured by real business impact: introducing Landing to new audiences and turning that attention into customers.

You'll be the first person to own this function. Reporting to the Senior Director of Performance Marketing, you'll have the budget, creative freedom, and autonomy to experiment, move quickly, and build a social program from the ground up, without waiting on layers of approvals.

**What you'll own**

* Paid social across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, and whatever earns its place next. Full budget authority. You'll own the paid social budget, with the autonomy to allocate spend, test new platforms, and scale what works. Measured on booked revenue and customer acquisition cost, tested for incrementality - not last-click.
* Organic social as a real channel, not a posting calendar. Organic is where we find our voice and test creative cheaply. The winners graduate to paid. Judged on audience growth, engagement that converts, and lift in people searching for us by name.
* The creative itself. You'll write it, direct it, and, in many cases, make it. We're not just going to hand you finished assets and ask you to buy against them.
* Testing. Audiences, hooks, formats, landing pages. Weekly cycles, documented results, and a real answer to "did this add anything we wouldn't have gotten anyway?"
* Some owner-facing content. Roughly 20% of our audience is multifamily owners and asset managers, mostly on LinkedIn. Different message, same discipline.
* Expect roughly 70% of your time on paid social, and the other 30% on consumer organic and owner-facing content.

**The creative bar**

* Our best-performing work names what's wrong with the alternatives. It's sharp, specific, and occasionally funny. It is not a beautifully shot film about belonging.
* If your portfolio is all polished brand work with no performance behind it, this probably isn't a fit. If you’ve made scrappy work that outperformed the expensive stuff and you can prove it (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CPA), send that.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years running paid social with real budget authority; you've personally owned the spend and been accountable for its return, not just its delivery.
* You make things. Copy, static, short-form video, whatever the platform is rewarding this quarter. Concept to post, without waiting on a designer.
* Organic instincts. You know what makes people stop scrolling and what makes them follow, and you can tell the difference between a post that performed and a post that mattered.
* You think about incrementality. Holdouts, geo splits, or something equally honest. You know why platform-reported ROAS is generous.
* Numbers don't scare you. CAC, payback, contribution. You can defend a budget request with math.
* You're resourceful and analytical. When performance drops, you don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You diagnose the problem, develop a hypothesis, and get to work testing a solution.
* You're AI native. You've used AI in your daily workflow for the last couple of years, with a real point of view on what you've used it to generate, iterate, and automate, and where it falls down.
* Volume over polish. Something imperfect this week beats something perfect next month.
* You're a fast learner. The platforms change constantly, and you pick up new tools and new ways of buying quickly.
* You can work daily from our San Francisco office.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $95K to $120K base (dependent on experience)
* **Bonus:** Performance bonus
* **Equity:** Included
* **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Disability, Mental Health, Pet, Commuter, and FSA or HSA
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan and access to ImmediatePay
* **PTO:** Generous PTO
* **Travel perk:** $750 annually in Landing Stays

We use this information to evaluate your application, communicate with you about opportunities, conduct any lawful background or reference checks, and meet our legal obligations. **About the Job**

With continued growth and increasing adoption among enterprise customers, our solution is rapidly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. **About Netradyne**

Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions, helping organizations improve driver safety, operational performance, and fleet visibility through AI-powered technology.

As our enterprise business continues to scale, we are evolving Customer Success into a more strategic, proactive, and commercially focused organization.

**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**

**Overview**

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager is a strategic customer-facing leader responsible for managing a focused portfolio of Netradyne's largest and most important enterprise customers.

This role combines customer strategy, operational execution, data-driven consulting, and commercial ownership to ensure customers maximize the value of Netradyne's AI-powered fleet safety platform.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager will own approximately 4–6 high-value enterprise customers representing $4M–$6M+ in ARR and lead the customer journey across implementation, adoption, value realization, retention, renewal, and expansion.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, helping customers define measurable business objectives, establish Customer Success Plans, accelerate deployment and adoption, and demonstrate tangible impact across safety, operations, and overall fleet performance.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager will also serve as the primary cross-functional leader for assigned accounts, partnering closely with Sales, Implementation, Product, Support, Field Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure customers view Netradyne as a strategic business partner rather than simply a technology provider.

The ideal candidate brings significant enterprise customer-facing experience, strong executive presence, commercial instincts, analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated record of driving adoption, retention, expansion, and measurable customer outcomes.

**Essential Functions**

**Executive Customer Leadership**

* Build trusted advisor relationships across multiple levels of each customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive decision-makers.
* Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Operations, Safety, IT, Finance, and other functional leadership teams.
* Understand each customer's business objectives, operational challenges, safety priorities, and ROI expectations.
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on measurable business outcomes and long-term value.
* Facilitate Executive Business Reviews focused on ROI, adoption, safety performance, operational improvements, and strategic priorities.
* Build multi-threaded relationships that strengthen customer retention and create long-term strategic partnerships.

**Strategic Enterprise Onboarding & Adoption**

* Own Customer Success strategy throughout enterprise implementation, deployment, onboarding, and adoption.
* Partner closely with Project Management, Implementation, and customer stakeholders to drive successful enterprise deployments.
* Maintain executive and stakeholder alignment throughout implementation.

**Job Title: Administrative Coordinator**

**Grade:** 18

**Salary:** $67,552-$81,257

The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. (RFMH) is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented candidate for the position of Administrative Coordinator in the Department of Comparative Medicine (DCM) at the New York State Psychiatric Institute (NYSPI).

Reporting directly to the Director of DCM, the Administrative Coordinator will provide administrative support to the Director and other DCM management. The Administrative Coordinator will manage the department's animal census data, maintain training records, and update website content. The incumbent will assist with the day-to-day operations through accurate record keeping, timely communication, and well-organized administrative processes.

Key responsibilities include calendar and meeting management, stakeholder communications, budget support, preparation for AAALAC and state inspections, animal census management and reconciliation in Tick@Lab.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Departmental Communication & Administrative Operations

* Serve as the DCM office's primary point of contact for administrative inquiries from investigators, research staff, vendors, and other stakeholders, providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses.
* Manage calendars for the Director and other DCM management. Schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and prepare and route general administrative correspondence.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate weekly animal care staff and supervisor meetings; prepare agendas, record accurate minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Coordinate and support preparation for triennial AAALAC site visits and the annual state inspection, including scheduling, document collection, and facility logistics.
* Operations & Budgetary Support

* Provide backup support for operational tasks (e.g., cage card printing and order review) and daily administrative workflows.
* Track invoices, vendor payments, and departmental expenses.
* Track and process annual institutional and individual membership renewals, ensuring timely filing and documentation.
* Assist the Director with budget estimations, tracking, and annual fiscal planning.
* Animal Census & Data Management

* Manage, audit, and reconcile animal census data (via Tick@Lab) to ensure data integrity, compliance, and accurate per diem billing.
* Maintain and optimize system configurations related to cage card census tracking, reconciliation workflows, error detection, and reporting.
* Partner closely with Animal Care Technicians and supervisory staff to identify census discrepancies, investigate root causes, and execute corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary liaison to NYSPI IT (psyIT) and software vendors (a-tune, the Tick@Lab vendor) to report and resolve technical issues; assist with system testing, updates, and configuration changes.
* Content Management & Training Support

* Assist with the development, formatting, maintenance, and publication of training materials, presentations, and learning modules for the DCM website and training platforms.
* Coordinate and maintain departmental electronic document management systems (e.g., OneDrive) and website content.
* Maintain and systematically track training records and compliance documentation for all personnel in the animal care and use program.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree or higher from an accredited institution, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of two (2) years of administrative support experience in a scientific, academic, medical, or research environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel, including sorting, filtering, lookups, and pivot tables) and experience with digital document management platforms (e.g., OneDrive, SharePoint).
* Experience with specialized compliance software or animal management databases (e.g., Tick@Lab).
* Knowledge of regulatory standards related to animal research (OLAW, AAALAC).
* Experience supporting an AAALAC-accredited animal care program or IACUC office.
* Experience maintaining website or intranet content (e.g., SharePoint sites, WordPress, or similar content management systems).

**Work Location:** 1051 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10032

**To Apply:** Submit an application through our website at https://rfmh.applicantpro.com/jobs/. Please note only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

The Mission of the Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. (RFMH) is to promote the mental health of all New Yorkers, with a focus on providing hope and supporting recovery for adults with serious mental illness and children with serious emotional disturbances. Applicants with lived mental health experience are encouraged to apply. RFMH is deeply committed to supporting underserved individuals, organizations, and communities. To this end, RFMH is focused on implementing activities and initiatives to reduce disparities in access, quality, and treatment outcomes for underserved populations. A critical component of these efforts is ensuring that RFMH is a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees' unique attributes and skills are valued and utilized to support the mission of the Agency. RFMH is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

The Research Foundation is a private not-for-profit corporation and is not an agency or instrumentality of the State of New York. Employees of the Research Foundation are not state employees, do not participate in any state retirement system, and do not receive state fringe benefits. Excellent Benefits Package. Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer - Disabled/Veteran, 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) compliant.

jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have fourteen offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than fifty countries.

Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue, the Client Account Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing the billing and collection strategy for their teams and in conjunction with firm best practices as well as in accordance with client requirements. This position will (i) collaborate with partners and practice groups leaders along with other Finance teams including the client reporting, strategic pricing and revenue operations teams, (ii) ensure team members are receiving appropriate training and development to respond effectively to partner or client requests, (iii) ensure teams are following client outside counsel guidelines and rates are in-line with client agreements before billing, and (iv) ensure quality and timely reporting for senior management.

Responsibilities:

* Oversee and lead the entire billing and collection process to ensure accurate and timely invoicing and payment of clients for assigned practice groups and/or offices.
* Monitor monthly aging AR reports and take appropriate action to ensure each invoice is paid on time and in full; direct teams to follow-up on underpayments and help with resolution, as needed.
* Performs regular audits of invoices to identify billing errors; identify training or development gaps on team and address.
* Ensure teams have documented for their areas of responsibility their partner requirements, key client requirements (billing, collecting, fee arrangements) in order to allow more streamlined collaboration and coverage among teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing efficiency and accuracy and implement strategies to achieve these goals.
* Review and analyze billing and collection data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
* Respond to billing and AR inquiries.
* Provide monthly updates on unbilled time and AR status, including reports, metrics and presentations.
* Collaborate with internal clients and other finance teams, such as Pricing Operations and ebilling, to ensure accurate client invoices, submission requirements, and reporting.
* Ensure team timely and accurately updates key finance reports (e.g., projection amounts, clear and concise billing or AR comments), to improve reporting for Senior Management.
* Participate in office and/or practice group meetings to understand strategy, challenges, goals of assigned practice groups or offices. Provide reports/updates, as required.
* Manage a team and provide training, development, and support.
* Follow-up with partners to escalate any billing or collection issues or delays.
* Build strong relationships across finance as well as practice groups and partners.
* Ensure adequate coverage during busy times (e.g. year-end, month-end).
* Develop or maintain billing policies and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal best practices, as well as client requirements.
* Provide training on billing best practices, software, reports, tools and any other revenue cycle-related tasks and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in and assigns personnel, as required, for technology testing and software reviews.
* Develop continuous process improvement reviews in order to help shorten revenue cycle timing, improve reporting, and matter intake information. Coordinate with technology teams, as needed.
* Special projects, as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or related fields
* Minimum of 7+ years of relevant billing and client relationship experience at a professional service firm or law firm is required.
* Minimum of 3 years in a manager role
* Proven record of implementing operational and procedural improvements.
* Experience with Aderant is a plus.
* Proficiency with Excel and Word.
* An innovative team player that is willing to pitch in when needed and offer ideas to better the group.
* Flexibility to work evenings and weekends to meet deadlines.

**Critical Competencies for Success:**

* Excellent writing, organizational and communication skills, which is effective at all levels, particularly with attorneys.
* Detail-oriented with a mastery of billing and collections processes, ability to investigate issues and errors, as well as strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, consensus-driven, partnership environment with highly skilled professionals.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000 at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of job-related factors, including skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities, geographic location, and performance. This is an exempt role, meaning it is not eligible for overtime pay.

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners and act as their advocate within Ekahau

accenture.com

.

jobs.title: Dropship Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

**American Exchange Group** is an industry leader in fashion accessory products and brand management. By facilitating distribution to major retailers internationally for their globally recognized brands, custom private label brands, and exclusive licensed brands—including footwear, tech wearables, watches, jewelry, handbags, fashion accessories, home, and beauty—American Exchange Group raises the bar by disrupting the status quo with value and quality, while staying at the forefront of trends.

  

Joining American Exchange Group means being part of a dynamic and diverse team where your contributions drive real impact—and where there’s always room to grow. If you're looking to be part of a company that blends heritage with hustle, we’re excited to meet you.

Visit our website at www.axnygroup.com

  

**Dropship Account Manager**

**Location:** New York City | On-site (4 day in office hybrid)

**Reports to:** Dropship Team Manager

**A****bout the Dropship Business**

American Exchange Group’s dropship business spans a growing portfolio of footwear brands and retail partners. Brands include Aerosoles, Allbirds, Rachel Zoe, and others with retail partners including Macy’s, Nordstrom, DSW, QVC, Belk, and others.

**Position Overview**

The Dropship Account Manager will own the day-to-day business and growth strategy for an assigned portfolio of brands and retail partner accounts, with accountability for sales, profitability, assortment productivity, and account performance. Brand and account assignments may evolve with business needs. This role serves as a primary point of contact for assigned retailer relationships, builds account plans, and turns sales and inventory insights into actions that drive profitable growth.

The ideal candidate brings proven sales and account management experience, strong commercial judgment, and a hands-on understanding of e-commerce and dropship operations. Working across merchandising, planning, marketing, technology, supply chain, wholesale, and direct-to-consumer teams, this person will lead account priorities from opportunity identification through execution and follow-up.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales and Account Ownership**

* Own retailer relationships and account performance within the assigned brand and account portfolio; build trusted partnerships with buyers, merchants, and e-commerce teams.
* Develop and execute plans for assigned brands and accounts to achieve sales and margin goals, including assortment expansion, new product launches, promotional opportunities, and improved product visibility.
* Lead regular retailer business reviews, presenting performance, opportunities, and recommended actions; track commitments through completion.
* Partner with leadership and planning to develop sales forecasts and account targets; monitor results and implement action plans to address gaps.
* Identify and pursue incremental sales opportunities, including expanded placements, seasonal programs, and new account opportunities in partnership with leadership.

**Merchandising and Profitability**

* Analyze sales, margin, sell-through, and inventory by brand, account, style, and SKU to recommend assortment, replenishment, and exit actions.
* Build brand- and account-specific assortment recommendations aligned with each retailer’s customer, inventory availability, and the positioning of each brand.
* Develop promotional and pricing recommendations that balance competitiveness, sales growth, and margin requirements; secure internal approvals and coordinate execution.
* Monitor competitor assortments, pricing, and promotions to identify market trends and product opportunities.

**Account Execution and Cross Functional Leadership**

* Own account readiness for launches and seasonal initiatives, coordinating product setup, content, pricing, inventory availability, and launch timelines.
* Manage retailer portals and coordinate onboarding and integrations with internal teams and external partners.
* Ensure product listings are accurate, complete, and optimized; resolve assortment, content, and availability issues that limit sales.
* Monitor fulfillment, cancellations, shipping timeliness, returns, and chargebacks; partner with operations and supply chain to resolve issues and protect retailer relationships.
* Coordinate priorities across assigned brands and accounts with dropship specialists and cross-functional partners, establishing clear owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
* Maintain account calendars, sales reporting, and action plans; recommend process improvements that support profitable growth and efficient execution.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of relevant sales and account management experience in wholesale, e-commerce, or retail, with direct ownership of customer relationships and sales results.
* Footwear or fashion company experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to grow accounts, identify commercial opportunities, and deliver against sales and profitability goals.
* Experience managing retailer partner accounts and navigating third-party retail platforms or vendor portals; dropship experience strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills, including Excel proficiency and the ability to translate sales, margin, and inventory data into clear recommendations.
* Understanding of retail math, pricing, promotional planning, assortment productivity, and inventory management.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills; comfortable leading retailer meetings and business reviews.
* Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to manage priorities across multiple brands and retail accounts, resolve issues, and drive cross-functional execution.
* Footwear, fashion, or accessories experience preferred.

**Measures of Success**

Success will be measured by sales growth and performance against account targets, margin results, assortment productivity and inventory health, growth in productive listings

jobs.title: Content Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a creative, organized, and proactive Social Media & Content Coordinator to support the company's growing content and social media efforts. This role reports to the Social Media, Influencer & Content Manager and is ideal for someone who enjoys both creating content and managing the day-to-day details that keep social channels active, responsive, and engaging.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with social media and content creation and is comfortable capturing photo and video content, performing basic video editing and graphic design, and supporting content production across a fast-paced marketing environment.

You'll work closely with and assist Fabuwood's Content Creator while collaborating with the broader marketing team to help increase the amount of content produced internally, strengthen community engagement, support influencer and partner activity, and contribute to larger productions and events. The goal is simple: consistently create useful, engaging content while helping Fabuwood stay active, responsive, and connected across social media.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM - 5:00PM, F 8:00AM - 12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Capture photo and video content on an ongoing basis for social media, internal marketing, product storytelling, events, and other brand initiatives.
* Photograph and film social-first content as needed, including product features, behind-the-scenes content, tutorials, employee or partner content, event coverage, and short-form video.
* Assist the Content Creator with day-to-day content production, including preparing for shoots, capturing supporting footage, organizing assets, and helping execute content concepts across social platforms.
* Edit short-form video and prepare content for social platforms, including basic trimming, captions, formatting, transitions, and platform-specific adjustments.
* Create simple graphic assets for social media using approved brand guidelines, helping supplement the workload of the graphic design team when appropriate.
* Assist with larger-scale content productions, photoshoots, launches, and events such as KBIS, including preparation, on-site content capture, and post-event content support.
* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, mentions, and other community interactions in a timely and brand-appropriate manner.
* Escalate customer concerns, sensitive messages, or issues to the Director of Marketing or appropriate internal team when additional support is needed.
* Proactively engage with designers, dealers, influencers, partners, and other relevant accounts to help strengthen relationships and expand Fabuwood's social presence.
* Track influencer and content-partner deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and contractual requirements to help ensure commitments are completed on time.
* Maintain organized content files and support the social media content calendar by helping coordinate assets, posting needs, deadlines, and upcoming opportunities.
* Provide additional social media and content support as needed, including trend monitoring, content research, asset gathering, and day-to-day marketing requests.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, communications, or a related role; strong internship or portfolio experience may also be considered.
* Hands-on experience capturing high-quality photo and video content using a smartphone, camera, or similar content-production tools.
* Basic video-editing skills and comfort creating short-form content for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, or similar channels.
* Basic graphic-design capabilities using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design platforms.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, community engagement, and platform-specific best practices.
* Excellent written communication skills with the judgment to represent a brand professionally in comments, messages, and public interactions.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple content requests, deadlines, and deliverables at once.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and content needs may shift quickly.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and know when to escalate questions, customer issues, or brand-sensitive situations.
* Comfortable using approved company-issued devices and account-access procedures to manage social media channels securely.
* A collaborative, hands-on attitude and willingness to support content capture at events, productions, showrooms, and other locations as needed.

**Preferred Skills**

* Comfortable appearing on camera when appropriate, whether demonstrating a product, participating in a tutorial, showing hands in a how-to video, or being featured in brand content.
* Experience working with influencers, creators, designers, or brand partners and tracking campaign deliverables.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, analytics, or listening tools is a plus.
* Interest in interior design, kitchen and bath, home products, building products, architecture, or related industries is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood is producing more strong, timely content internally while maintaining an active and responsive social presence. Content is captured consistently, social communities receive thoughtful engagement, influencer commitments are tracked, and the marketing team has a dependable partner who can identify opportunities and help move content from idea to execution.

At Fabuwood, we value people who take ownership of their work, bring ideas forward, move quickly without sacrificing quality, and contribute to a collaborative, results-focused marketing team.

jobs.title: Gym Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Description:

At FIELDHOUSE, we believe wellness is a shared experience shaped through community, lived in movement, and renewed through recovery. As a fitness and wellness club built around a personalized, community-driven approach, we're looking for a dependable and detail-oriented Gym Operations Associate to join our team at The Park in Berkeley Heights, NJ—someone who takes pride in keeping our spaces clean, organized, and welcoming while helping ensure every member enjoys a seamless and comfortable experience.

This role supports FIELDHOUSE's daily operations by ensuring towels are consistently available, gym spaces stay clean and organized, and members receive friendly, attentive service. We're looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and proud to maintain the high standards of cleanliness and hospitality that define the FIELDHOUSE experience.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Collect used towels from locker rooms, shower areas, gym floors, equipment, benches, and designated bins across both FIELDHOUSE locations.
* Transport used towels to the laundry service or facility on schedule.
* Accurately count towels before delivery and upon return, maintaining detailed records in the towel log.
* Report discrepancies, shortages, or inventory concerns to the General Manager promptly.
* Inspect returned towels for cleanliness and quality, setting aside any that are stained, damaged, or worn.
* Fold, organize, and restock clean towels throughout FIELDHOUSE 400 and FIELDHOUSE 200 to ensure members have what they need.
* Monitor towel inventory levels and notify the General Manager when supplies fall below established levels.
* Keep open gym areas clean, orderly, and safe throughout each shift.
* Return weights, mats, balls, and other fitness accessories to their designated storage areas.
* Identify and report damaged or unsafe equipment to the General Manager.
* Provide front desk coverage during breaks, busy periods, and staffing absences.
* Welcome members and guests, assist with check-ins, and answer questions about gym hours, services, and policies.
* Answer incoming calls and direct inquiries to the appropriate team members.
* Respond to member questions and concerns with professionalism and courtesy, escalating issues when appropriate.
* Maintain FIELDHOUSE's standards for cleanliness, hospitality, and member service.

Requirements:

**What You'll Bring**

* Previous experience in a fitness facility, hospitality, retail, or customer service environment is a plus.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation for laundry deliveries.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when counting inventory and maintaining accurate records.
* A dependable, organized approach to work, with the ability to manage responsibilities independently.
* Friendly, professional communication skills and a willingness to assist members and teammates.
* Basic computer skills and comfort learning front desk check-in or point-of-sale systems; training will be provided.
* The ability to lift and carry loads of towels weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and fold towels for extended periods.
* The ability to move between FIELDHOUSE 400 and FIELDHOUSE 200 as needed.

**Supporting Your Success**

* Medical coverage with employer contribution
* Generous employer-funded retirement plan
* Paid time off
* Employee dining and hospitality perks across The Park
* Opportunities for professional development, fitness education, and growth within the wellness industry

At FIELDHOUSE, we believe every interaction is an opportunity to create a meaningful experience. If you're passionate about fitness and wellness, take pride in supporting others, and want to be part of a team dedicated to creating a welcoming and exceptional member experience, we invite you to apply and grow with us.

While we leverage technology to support our recruiting process, every application is personally reviewed by a member of our Human Resources team because we recognize that behind every resume is a person, a career journey, and a genuine interest in joining our organization.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Founding Sales Development Representative**  
Brooklyn, New York (Hybrid)

**Ready to stop running on someone else’s playbook and write your own?**

**About Haast**

We aren’t experimenting with AI. We’re shipping one of the first enterprise-grade AI platforms for compliance, already in production with global enterprises. Our platform helps legal, compliance and marketing teams move through reviews up to 80% faster, with a 4x boost in productivity.

We’ve recently raised a $12M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, with DST Global and Airtree. Now we’re building the commercial engine to match.

Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.

**Why this role exists**

Compliance is a $50B global opportunity, and every deal we close starts with a conversation. Right now, nobody’s job is to start them. That’s where you come in.

As our first SDR, based in our Brooklyn office, you’ll work side by side with our CEO and Founding Enterprise AE. You’ll build the pipeline behind Haast’s next stage of growth and write the playbook every SDR after you will run.

**What you’ll own**

Most of your time goes into creating qualified pipeline. The rest goes into building the process that lets others do the same.

**Pipeline**

* **Phone first:** Run daily outbound across phone, email and LinkedIn into target accounts. The phone is your first move, not your last resort.
* **Warm pipeline:** Work the demand that marketing generates through content, events, webinars and community, and act fast on the inbound signals that matter, from website visits to demo requests.
* **Events into meetings:** Personally invite the right people beforehand, then co-own follow-up with our Founding Enterprise AE to book meetings while the momentum is there.
* **Discovery that holds up:** Run structured discovery against our ideal customer profile and book meetings our Founding Enterprise AE accepts.

**Playbook and process**

* **Write the playbook:** Build, test and document talk tracks, sequences, objection handling and qualification criteria. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t.
* **Own the numbers:** Keep our CRM clean, report on meetings booked, acceptance rate and conversion, and recommend changes to tools and process.
* **AI as leverage:** Use AI to multiply your output across account research, personalization and sequencing, and keep testing new workflows.
* **Voice of the market:** Bring what you hear on calls back to marketing, product and sales leadership: which titles respond, which industries engage, the objections and the buying triggers. Your insight sharpens our ICP and personas.

**You might be a fit if you:**

* **Have outgrown your seat:** You’re an experienced SDR or BDR from B2B software who consistently hits or beats meeting and pipeline targets, and you’re ready for a role you get to build.
* **Improve the process, not just follow it:** You’ve built or rebuilt sequences and you can show what changed as a result.
* **Love the numbers:** You track your own funnel, run message tests, and can explain what you changed and why.
* **Hold your own with senior buyers:** You’re comfortable engaging director level and above, and bringing several functions into one conversation.
* **Write and speak with credibility:** Clear, concise and confident with people who are paid to be skeptical.
* **Already work with AI:** Claude, ChatGPT or similar are part of how you research and prospect today, not something you’re planning to try.
* **Know the tools:** HubSpot (or Salesforce), LinkedIn Sales Navigator and any other tools you've seen work well.

**Nice to have, but not essential**

* Selling to marketing, compliance, legal or risk buyers
* A background in compliance software, regtech or legal tech
* Time at an early-stage startup where things moved quickly!

**Why Haast**

* **A founding seat:** Be the first SDR at a Series A company and shape how we go to market.
* **Clear (and fast) growth pathway:** Build the function, prove it works, then lead the team that follows or step up into enterprise sales ownership if that's the route you want to take
* **Compensation:** Base salary $60-$80k USD with up to 30% on top in commission and meaningful equity options.
* **Flexibility:** Hybrid from our Brooklyn office.
* **Benefits:** Health insurance, 401k and generous PTO
* **Learning velocity:** Learn more in 12 months than most roles offer in three years, with daily access to our CEO and Founding Enterprise AE.
* **Traction behind you:** You’ll be opening doors for a product global enterprises already trust, with the results to back it up.

**Ready to build the pipeline you’ll be talking about for the rest of your career?**

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV and the first email you’d send to win a meeting. Pick a company you think should be talking to Haast and write to their Head of Compliance in under 120 words. If you used AI to help, tell us how.

At Haast, we believe bold ideas come from diverse perspectives. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in, across gender, background, orientation, ability and experience. Even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

*Applications reviewed on an ongoing basis, no closing date.*

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K

jobs.title: Apparel Packaging Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in 1954 on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, Gold Medal International (GMI) has established itself as one of the leading hosiery and accessories companies in the industry. GMI designs, sources, and manufactures wholesale socks and accessories for a customer base ranging from small independent stores to the most prestigious department stores in the country.

Creating great employee experiences has always been a priority at GMI. We know first-hand that when we take care of our employees, they will take care of our customers, and we strive for this every day.

Through our best times and challenging times, we remain inspired by the resilience of our team. Leadership recognizes the value in providing workplace flexibility, and our hybrid-remote work model has had a tremendous impact on the quality of life for our employees. GMI commits to maintaining high levels of customer service, and we take pride in our reputation for treating everyone like family.

About The Role

We are seeking a part-time Packaging Production Coordinator who will report to the Vice President of Sourcing in the New York metropolitan area. This is a regular part-time, hourly role scheduled for 24 – 30 hours per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, working on site in our NYC office, with extra hours available during our peak production season. You will be the final check that our packaging, test reports, and Top of Production (TOP) samples all line up before product ships, and you will take key follow-up work off our Production Managers' plates.

About You

You are the person who notices when a UPC scans as “Navy” but the sock in your hand is charcoal. You like checking details, and you don't mind checking them twice. You write clear, direct emails, including to factory partners overseas, and you know when to fix something yourself and when to flag it for the team. You can manage several open items at once within a part-time schedule, and you keep good records so nothing slips between your workdays.

What You Will Do

Our Packaging Production Coordinator protects the quality of every item that reaches our customers. You will compare test reports, care labels, and packaging layouts to make sure they match, confirm that UPCs and lot numbers scan correctly, and approve TOP samples. You will also support our Production Managers by tracking test reports in the WIP (Work in Progress) report, maintaining shipping material samples, and preparing cost sheets and documents so orders keep moving.

Packaging Review and Approval

* Review each test report to confirm it is valid and current, and that it lists the correct brands and styles.
* Check packaging layouts against the test report and care labels so fiber content and wash instructions match.
* Review the factory's digital packaging proof against the file we sent, confirming fonts, copy, and every requested detail carried over before final print.
* Scan UPCs to confirm they read correctly and pull up the right style, color, and product information.
* Confirm the Country of Origin (COO) has been updated on all packaging.
* Confirm all required testing in the PO testing protocol has been completed and passed.
* Approve TOP samples by confirming final packaging matches all testing and that UPCs and lot numbers scan correctly.

Test Reports and WIP Follow-Up

* Receive test reports through the testing distribution list, file them, and begin review.
* Flag any callouts or failures to the Production team, who lead corrections with the factory.
* When a brand or style is listed incorrectly, email the factory with the correction and copy the distribution list so Production stays informed.
* Monitor and follow up on the test report portion of the WIP report.
* Time final checks so packaging and test results are reviewed together, avoiding duplicate work.

Production Team Support

* Maintain approval samples of shipping materials, such as carton cuttings, polybags, and customer-specific UPCs.
* Monitor the missing DIMS (carton dimensions) report to confirm dimensions meet our carton requirements and are submitted on time.
* Create cost sheets so purchase orders can be issued.
* Check documents so import folders can be entered.
* Assist with inspection report approvals during peak season.
* Manage sample bins and empty them once TOP samples are approved.

What You Will Need

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Experience in apparel, accessories, or consumer product production, packaging, or quality control.
* Working knowledge of test reports, care labels, and UPC barcodes, or the ability to learn them quickly.
* Ability to prioritize and manage time effectively within a part-time schedule.
* Clear, professional written communication, including email with overseas factories.
* Proficient with Microsoft Excel and the entire Office 365 application.
* Experience with PLM or ERP systems is a plus.
* Comfortable working on site with a team that includes hybrid-remote colleagues.
* Availability for additional hours during peak season.

Why You’ll Love Working at GMI

For more than 70 years, GMI has been a family-style company. We take care of our people, and they take care of our customers.

* Set part-time schedule: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 8 hours a day (24 hours a week) in our NYC office, with Mondays and Fridays off.
* 5 days of paid time off: 40 hours of PTO that covers both vacation and sick time. It is available on January 1 (prorated in your first year), and you can use it right away.
* Hands-on experience: see how product moves from factory testing to the retail shelf, working alongside an experienced Production team.
* Growth: a pay review every year and support to keep learning.

Our Values

* Honest: we’re open and fair, and we keep our word.
* People-First: we treat employees, customers, and partners with respect.
* Proactive: we spot problems early and act.
* Flexible: we support work-life balance and adapt to what customers need.

jobs.description:
**About the Organization — Violence Intervention Program (VIP)**  
Established by Black and Latina activists in 1984, the Violence Intervention Program (VIP) is NYC’s only culturally specific organization with a mission to address domestic and sexual violence within Latine communities. Each year, we provide intensive support and services to 3,500+ survivors and children and reach 15,000+ community members through community events and preventive education. We are committed to developing innovative programs that respond to the needs of our diverse community and reflect our organizational values.  
  
**About the Role — Development Assistant**  
This is an excellent opportunity for an organized professional looking to build a career in nonprofit fundraising while advancing social justice. As Development Assistant, you’ll work closely with the Associate Director of Individual Giving and Operations to gain hands-on experience in donor stewardship, fundraising administration, database management, and special events.  
  
As part of our small but mighty team, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across VIP, interact directly with donors, partners, and members of our Board of Directors, and jump in wherever needed to keep development operations running smoothly.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Support individual and corporate fundraising efforts, including donor and prospect research.
* Maintain accurate donor records, gifts, interactions, and notes in VIP’s donor database.
* Prepare gift acknowledgments, thank-you letters, and other donor correspondence.
* Generate donor reports, prospect and mailing lists, and other fundraising data.
* Help keep development files, documents, and procedures organized and up to date.
* Support fundraising events, including VIP’s annual benefit, with event logistics, communications, materials, donor lists, sponsor recognition, and follow-up.
* Provide administrative support to the Associate Director, including calendar management, meeting agendas, notes, and follow-up.

  
**What You’ll Need**

* 1–3 years of relevant work experience.
* **Systems and data comfort:** High comfort managing data, generating reports, and maintaining donor database integrity with precision.
* **Organizational chops:** Strong project coordination and time-management skills, with pride in delivering accurate, orderly, and polished work.
* **Exceptional communication:** Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage thoughtfully with diverse community partners and donors.
* **Mission alignment:** A grounded commitment to VIP’s mission of supporting survivors and ending gender-based violence.
* **Language:** Fluency in English is required; Spanish proficiency or fluency is a strong plus.

  
**Compensation & Benefits**  
As an organization led by and for people of color and survivors of violence, we care deeply about our team’s wellness. We offer unlimited PTO, flexible work schedules, a hybrid workplace, health benefits coverage up to 90% for staff and their families, a 403(b) retirement plan, a staff-led wellness committee, and dedicated time to connect as a team. We are an evolving workplace and welcome input from our staff as we continue building an affirming, uplifting culture.  
  
The hiring range for this position is an annual salary of $60,000 to $65,000. The final salary within this range is determined based on candidate qualifications and relevant experience. To uphold equity across our team, once an offer is made, we do not negotiate compensation.  
  
**Location & Schedule**

* Office Location: East Harlem (near the Lexington & 125th St station).
* In-Office Schedule: Full-time position requiring at least two days per week in the office.
* Remote Schedule: You are welcome to work remotely during regular office hours the remainder of the week, with occasional additional in-person days based on operational and event needs.
* Event Attendance: Core member of the development team expected to attend all VIP fundraising and networking events.

  
**The Application Process**  
VIP has engaged Equitable Hiring Group to support this hiring process. To apply, please complete the short form to the right.  
  
Please submit your application by **Wednesday, November 11th.** Our simple process makes it easy to apply early!  
  
To ensure an equitable review, we ask that you remove the names of the schools you attended (both undergraduate and graduate) from your resume. Please retain the degree itself. For example, instead of "Greendale Community College - B.A. Economics," simply list "B.A. Economics."  
  
This evaluation process will follow practices shown to reduce bias in decision-making and may be different from other application processes you have experienced.  
  
The overall evaluation process will look to follow this anticipated timeline:

* Early November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a short-answer questionnaire.
* Mid-November: Selected candidates will participate in a video interview with VIP staff.
* Late November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid, timed trial project.
* Early December: Selected candidates will participate in a video panel interview with multiple team members.
* Early December: Finalist candidates will come for an in-person interview and tour our office.
* Mid December: Offer extended.
* Early January: Anticipated Start Date

If you have any questions about the opportunity, please email abe@equitablehiringgroup.com.

**WHO WE ARE**

KNAPP brings new technology to warehouse automation.

The KNAPP Group is a global provider of intelligent automation solutions for intralogistics and manufacturing, specializing in the sectors healthcare, fashion/apparel, general retail, food retail, industry and service. We live and breathe automation. We, more than 8,000 employees of the KNAPP Group across over 60 locations worldwide, shaping the future-oriented intralogistics industry, are dedicated to making complexity simple.

One of KNAPP’s primary goals is to use continuous innovation to drive warehouse automation forward, always with the specific needs of the customers in mind. KNAPP Group’s unrelenting development activity is evident in everything from automated order picking systems and continuing refinement of container handling technology to its state-of-the-art, industry leading software solutions.

**WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

The Procurement Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily procurement operations through purchase request processing, purchase order management, supplier communication, goods receiving, invoice reconciliation, and general procurement administration.  
The role ensures timely and accurate procurement transactions while maintaining compliance with company policies, project requirements, and financial controls.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Procurement Administration**

* Create, manage, and modify Purchase Orders in SAP.

* Coordinate order confirmations and delivery schedules.
* Assist internal stakeholders with procurement-related inquiries.
* Maintain procurement documentation and records.

* Maintain project procurement documentation and reporting.

* 1+ years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, logistics, receiving, or administrative functions.
* Experience with SAP or comparable ERP systems preferred.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and customer-service mindset.

**Working Conditions and Environment:**

* Occasional domestic travel.

* Half day Fridays
* A beautiful new, state-of-the-art, office complex in Kennesaw, GA
* Industry competitive compensation
* Great benefits with better than average employer contributions, including health, dental, vision, life insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short & Long Term Disability and more!

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Hybrid Account Manager
jobs.description:
Pharmaceutical Hybrid Account Manager - Women’s Healthcare
  
Southeast Region
  
  
Ready to take your pharmaceutical sales career beyond the phone?
  
  
EXCITING TEAM EXPANSION WITH EXELTIS PHARMACEUTICALS! (DIRECT HIRE WITH EXELTIS)
  
  
Be part of the Top Talent Team at Exeltis! Exeltis is seeking motivated Hybrid Account Managers with a successful background in pharmaceutical/biopharma virtual / inside sales who are ready to step into the field and take their sales impact to the next level!
  
  
If you’re a results-driven sales professional with proven success driving sales over the phone, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for building strong customer relationships, this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. With flexibility to travel up to 50%, you’ll have the chance to expand your reach, connect with customers face-to-face, and grow your career in the field.
  
  
Ready to turn your inside sales success into field sales success? We want to hear from you! This is a full-time opportunity with Exeltis Pharmaceuticals to bring innovative solutions where there is a need for strategic account coverage. Go to View Openings & Apply Here to view the job and apply.
  
  
Why Exeltis?
  
  
Expect Extraordinary when you join Exeltis! Our team insists on – and delivers on – Extraordinary in everything we do. At Exeltis, everyone is made to feel welcome and everyone’s ideas count, because we believe in caring for and supporting our people. When you join the Exeltis family, you’ll find yourself collaborating with extraordinary colleagues from all walks of life, and you’ll be supported with opportunities for growth and learning at every stage of your career
  
  
Exeltis offers a competitive benefits package including Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, Disability and Life Insurance, Generous PTO, Emerging Leader Development Program, as well as a robust Wellness Program and 401K plan.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will act as the primary customer contact within an assigned territory by creating demand and executing sales & marketing strategies in the promotion of key products in Exeltis’ Women’s Healthcare portfolio. You’ll be calling on OB/GYN’s and Family Practice accounts. The Hybrid Account Manager will spend much of their time utilizing virtual (phone-based) interactions while also traveling out of state up to 50% per month within the assigned region to make in-person field calls on Super Target accounts.
  
  
Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Drive strategic product promotion by executing targeted sales initiatives for Exeltis Pharmaceuticals’ Women’s Health portfolio through phone-based outreach, virtual meetings, and in-person field engagement.
* Utilizes knowledge, critical thinking, and dialogue skills to deliver meaningful customer experiences that result in satisfaction and loyalty.
* Anticipates, identifies, and appropriately addresses HCP and account objections, questions, and concerns, utilizing all appropriate resources and information, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Host virtual meetings to educate accounts on product usage and patient profiles.
* Meet or exceed daily and monthly call targets while efficiently managing administrative tasks.
* Maintain detailed records in the CRM system per company policy.
* Remain compliant with all company & FDA regulations and policies while carrying out responsibilities.
* Plans and schedules meetings and lunch programs at accounts for the week deployed in the field.
* Travels to Super Target accounts to educate on product usage and patient profiles.
* Meet or exceed sales target goals for territory.

Qualifications for the role
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Minimum of 2 years of phone-based sales experience, pharmaceutical/biopharma is a plus.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Self-starter with the ability to work independently and adapt quickly.
* Women’s Health sales experience is plus.
* Strong digital communication and CRM proficiency.
* Excellent interpersonal, listening, and presentation skills.
* Organized, self-motivated, and able to manage a remote territory effectively.
* Skilled in using phone and video technologies to build relationships.
* Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.
* Must be willing and able to travel out of state with overnight stays approximately one week per month to cover Super Target accounts across the multi-state Region and/or attend conferences.

Exeltis Overview
  
  
Exeltis is an independent, family-owned women’s healthcare company passionately committed to serving patients, making a contribution to society and caring for the wellbeing of our employees. As a company, we offer an innovative portfolio, delivering unique solutions to real problems in women’s health. Our vision is of a world where women are empowered to lead their healthiest lives. By supporting women’s health at every stage of life, from fertility, healthy pregnancies, and contraception to menopause. To learn more about Exeltis and our products visit, http://exeltisusa.com/.
  
  
If you have a proven record of success and the desire to have a positive impact in the healthcare field, we want to hear from you. Apply at, Job Openings - ImpactBio
  
  
Exeltis is an equal opportunity employer M/F/V/D. We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only qualified candidates will be considered.

Würth USA is looking for an enthusiastic Territory Sales Representative to maintain and grow a territory while also strengthening customer relationships, ensuring customer satisfaction, and meeting individual and company sales targets. This is a hands-on, field-based role combining sales, account management, and physical inventory work. You will be expected to sell, build relationships, and physically manage product inside customer locations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and grow nearly 75 active accounts
* Prospect and develop new business
* Stock, organize, and replenish inventory at customer sites
* Move, handle, and position equipment (ORSY systems, vending machines) as needed
* Travel across a large territory
* Handle customer concerns, follow-ups, and operational issues
* Work and engage with decision makers through cold calling and prospecting.
* Manage a territory by making daily visits (8-12) to dealerships, collisions, and automotive repair facilities.
* Develop and implement a strategic sales plan to increase revenue and market share within the assigned territory.
* Build and maintain solid relationships with customers, identifying their needs and providing tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction and resolve any issues or concerns.
* Provide value added services such as ordering product, inventory management, and problem solving.
* Showcase the quality of WURTH products and services through presentations and demonstrations.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Self-starter mentality
* Strong organization and time management
* Willingness to do physical, hands-on work
* Ability to prospect and grow accounts
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* High school diploma or equivalent work experience.
* A minimum of 1 year of sales experience, preferred.
* Demonstrated professionalism and customer service experience.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to collaborate and maintain relationships with decision makers.
* Ability to lift and carry items weighing up to 50 lbs., with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Valid driver’s license.

**What Würth USA Offers You:**

* Work with an exciting automotive brand that sponsors NASCAR races.
* Opportunities for growth and career advancement within the company.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment with a fun and upbeat company culture where you can be yourself
* Extensive in-house training on product, selling techniques, and more.
* Excellent benefits package.

**Job Type**: Full-time

**Compensation:**

* Total Target Compensation: $65,000 – $70,000
* Base Salary: ~$42,000 – $45,500
* Bonus Structure:
  + Begins at 90% target achievement
  + Scales to 150%
  + Based on sales + product mix
* Company Vehicle + Gas Card Provided

While the anticipated total compensation for this position begins at $65,000, actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, relevant experience, job-related skills, and other considerations.

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

  

**About Würth USA:**

* Wurth USA is one of the leading suppliers of high-quality automotive parts, products, and services. Our extensive catalog of hardware, chemicals, fasteners, hand tools and more provides our customers with everything they need to succeed. Small body shops and nation-wide fleet maintenance companies alike can benefit from the unparalleled selection and unbeatable service that is synonymous with the Wurth brand.
* We have more than 40,000 customers across the nation including body shops, cargo industry businesses, motorcycle repair shops, MRO industry players, auto dealerships, government agencies, and vocational schools.
* At Wurth every customer is treated with the same level of respect and attention. We take pride in the fact that we employ some of the most highly trained sales representatives in the industry. Our professional sales staff works tirelessly to build mutually beneficial relationships with each of our customers that last for years.

  

**Devoted to Crafting Quality Automotive Supplies**

* The Wurth Group has a superb team of researchers and developers devoted to crafting the best auto repair supplies in the industry.
* Our inventory includes top-quality automotive chemicals, fasteners, electrical supplies, hardware, cargo chemicals, automotive hand tools, rivets, and a wide selection of specialty auto body repair supplies.
* Businesses ranging from small exotic car body shops to large cargo companies can find all the automotive body shop supplies they'll need.

jobs.description:
**About NCR**

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a leader in transforming, connecting and running technology platforms for self-directed banking, stores and restaurants. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Ga., with 14,000 employees globally. NCR Voyix is a trademark of NCR Voyix Corporation in the United States and other countries.

**Your Impact as a Sales Development Associate – Emerging Talent**

You're driven by curiosity, passionate about business and technology, and see the world a little differently than your peers.

Our Sales Development Program offers the opportunity to launch your sales career with the #1 global provider of POS and self-checkout software, powering more than 400 million transactions every day for many of the world's leading retail & restaurant brands. Designed for early-career talent, this role serves as a launchpad to future Account Executive and SDR leadership opportunities.

**Note: This full-time program begins in July 2027.**

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Identify and engage with retail & restaurant prospects through calls, email, and social outreach, building early relationships that generate new business opportunities

jobs.description:
**Territory: Atlanta**

  

Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. With our trusted regulatory experience, insights, and infrastructure, we help manufacture and source medical products that meet the demand for value-driven, comprehensive healthcare solutions.

  

**Job Summary**

The **Territory Sales Representative - Surgery Centers (ASC)** is responsible for securing and maintaining distribution channel as well as growing Cardinal Health Brand and Preferred National Brand products within free-standing Ambulatory Surgery Centers. The complexity of the solutions, products, and services offered is varied and can range from simple to moderately complex selling and longer sales cycle. The role reports into the Region Director, ASC and it is important that they can build and maintain relationships with key decision makers and potential influencers. Focus areas will include driving new business as well as increasing penetration in existing accounts.

* Develop and manage successful key relationships within ASC customers to achieve sales goals in assigned territory.

* Collaborates both internally and externally within various business units such as key contacts within national accounts, GPO Reps, and other vendors to archive results.
* Conducts data analytics and analyzes the market penetration on products both in new and existing clients. Responsible for identifying areas for development.
* Coordinates pre-call planning with sales support staff and delegates data collection to potential other team members.

* Maintain required sales activity level - examples include the number of expected visits & calls, number of products presented/account, etc.
* Assists distribution order support and coordination as needed. Assist customers with back-orders and other related service issues
* Maintain knowledge of the current industry/competitive landscape including, GPO's, healthcare economics, reimbursement, competitors, competitive products, etc.
* Travel within assigned territory to call on accounts including overnight travel. Maintain active, in-person presence at top accounts

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience preferred
* Experience in sales, account/relationship management, or customer success preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills including active listening, experience in developing and delivering presentations to both small and large groups
* Self-motivated and proactive with a strong work ethic and a willingness to take initiative
* A critical thinker with a problem-solving attitude, consistently seeking opportunities to improve processes and resolve issues efficiently
* Possesses a resilient and confident attitude, with the ability to overcome obstacles and maintain a positive outlook
* Technology proficiency with CRM software such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite
* A valid driver's license issued in one of the 50 States with a clean driving record
* Ability to travel up to 50% within territory including overnight stays
* Customer/Vendor credentialing may be required (this may include vaccinations). More details will be provided if you are selected for an interview

**Anticipated pay range:** $125,200 - $146,660 (includes targeted variable pay)

**Bonus eligible:** Yes

**Benefits:** Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

* 401k savings plan

Healthy lifestyle programs
