jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Onit:**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**About this Job:**

Onit is looking for a motivated, intelligent, and driven Sales Development Representative (SDR). SDRs play a crucial role driving the top of the sales funnel through outbound outreach. You will find new business opportunities prospecting clients across industries working closely with field account executives, sales engineers, and others across teams. Onit's SDRs receive world class training, support, and mentoring from proven SDR leaders, dedicated SMEs, and our broader team of sales and marketing leadership. Our SDRs ramp fast and often move into sales roles that involve closing, but the SDR position is foundational to Onit’s success. New opportunities will emerge fast once SDRs prove themselves in this crucial role.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Research and identify target prospects, then perform high-quality outreach.
* Qualify prospects with high quality discovery questions & discussion.
* Manage all SDR elements from research and first meeting to sales accepted lead.
* Strategically manage a high volume of outbound emails and phone calls.
* Maintain engagement with prospects using creative approaches.
* Think critically about what drives your accepted meetings, and from that, share scalable outreach strategies w/ your SDR team.
* Optimize your use of key SDR tools to win (Salesforce, Outreach, Zoominfo, Nooks and Sales Navigator).
* Hit or exceed quota for setting discovery calls and demos.

### **Required Skills:**

* 2+ year of work experience, ideally customer-facing or sales-adjacent.
* Prior experience prospecting outbound strategic accounts ($1B+ Annual Revenue) required.
* Excellent communication. Clear writing, confident speaking - non-negotiable.
* Empathy and integrity. You’re curious about people and do the right thing.
* Active listening + storytelling. You connect dots and make it memorable.
* Comfort with change. New plays, new targets, new tools—let’s roll.
* Organized and detailed. You can juggle tasks and keep your pipeline tidy.
* Coachable mindset. You want feedback and use it to get better fast.
* Competitive drive. You like to win and make things happen.
* Experience in a B2B enterprise software environment is a plus, but by no means required.
* A Bachelor’s degree - it shows you can set a big goal and finish it.

$28.85 - $28.85 an hour

Base salary: $60,000

Commission: $40,000

OTE: $100,000

This position will be 100% on-site during the initial ramp period, giving you the chance to fully immerse yourself in our collaborative office culture—complete with team events, networking opportunities, and a supportive environment that makes coming to work enjoyable. You’ll also have access to enablement resources to help you grow and succeed. Once you’re fully ramped and consistently meeting performance expectations, you’ll have the opportunity to transition to a flexible hybrid model (3–4 days per week in the office).

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

**Health Coverage Choices:** Three medical plan options, plus dental and vision, so you can choose what fits best. Employees on our HDHP plan also receive employer contribution to the HSA.

**Retirement Savings:** 401(k) with a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of employee contributions.

**Time Away:** Flexible paid time off, 7 sick days, and 9 paid company holidays annually.

**Family Support:** Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.

**Income Protection:** 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.

**Additional Coverage Options:** Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and even pet insurance.

**Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Healthcare FSA, HSA, and dependent care FSA.

**Community Engagement:** One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

This position will remain open for applications for 7 calendar days from the posting date.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Operations Coordinator CAQH, CMS & PECOS portal exp required!
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Revenue Cycle Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day revenue cycle activities, including provider enrollment, payer maintenance, medical records coordination, and revenue integrity tasks. This role takes ownership of maintaining accurate payer data, resolving issues as they arise, supporting audits, and helping ensure revenue cycle processes run smoothly and in compliance with payer and company requirements. Reports directly to the Vice President, Revenue Operations.

**JOB SPECIFIC EXPECTATIONS**

**Provider Enrollment & Payer Operations**

* Independently coordinate ongoing provider and group enrollment maintenance, including CAQH updates, attestations, and payer demographic changes.
* Maintain and monitor payer portals, ensuring accuracy of provider, banking, and participation data across payers.
* Review, triage, and process payer correspondence and mail, identifying action items and coordinating follow-up with internal stakeholders.
* Support and respond to Medicaid and commercial payer audits, including documentation preparation, variance identification, and issue resolution.
* Perform provider group audits (e.g., Verity), analyzing payer alignment and initiating corrective actions as needed.
* Conduct EFT and virtual credit card (VCC) payment audits, identifying discrepancies, recommending resolutions, and escalating issues when appropriate.

**Payor Strategy & Rate Maintenance**

* Coordinate maintenance of contracted payer rates within the corporate master rate file.
* Validate rate accuracy against executed agreements and escalate discrepancies for review.
* Support payer strategy initiatives by maintaining clean, reliable rate and participation data.

**Revenue Cycle & Medical Records Coordination**

* Oversee chart flow tracking within Arietis, identifying bottlenecks and coordinating resolution to support timely billing.
* Coordinate provider schedule and reconciliation activities related to GCA and records management.
* Manage secure file transfers via FTP, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and company data security standards.
* Maintain and update operations master files, exercising judgment to ensure data integrity across revenue cycle workflows.
* Perform records reconciliation, evaluating completeness and resolving discrepancies.
* Coordinate scanning and indexing of medical records received in the ATL office to ensure timely system availability.
* Monitor and independently respond to inquiries received via **service@crhanesthesia.com**, determining appropriate resolution paths.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

***Education & Qualifications:***

**Education**: High School Diploma with Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent healthcare revenue cycle experience considered.

**Licensure & Certifications:** N/A

**Previous Experience:** Two years plus (2+ ) years of experience in revenue cycle operations, provider enrollment, payer maintenance, or medical records coordination required in a healthcare setting.

**Skills**:Working knowledge of CAQH, payer portals, EFT/VCC payments, and healthcare data management systems, with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-driven, able to manage multiple workflows independently, meet strict deadlines, and perform well in a fast-paced, high-volume healthcare environment. Effective written and verbal communicator with excellent customer service skills, capable of engaging internal teams, providers, payers, and external partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality. Maintains accurate physician and practitioner credentialing and payer enrollment records across multiple states and builds productive relationships with payer representatives, providers, and billing and contracting partners to support timely enrollment, issue resolution, and protect revenue integrity.

**Computer Skills:** The credentialing department works in a mostly paper-free environment. Previous experience with provider credentialing/enrollment software (i.e. VerityStream) necessary. Expertise in Microsoft Office (Excel and Word). Proficiency with standard business software (Microsoft Windows, and PowerPoint) and using a laptop and mobile device is required.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Revenue cycle management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

As a global market intelligence agency, our understanding of consumers, innovation, and markets gives clients the clarity to act and the confidence to lead. As an Account Manager within the Strategic Partner Accounts team, you are responsible for driving client retention, growth, and value realization across a portfolio of global enterprise clients - including strategic anchor accounts, which span multiple business units, regions, and buying centers operating under a single global relationship.

This is an individual contributor role with full ownership of renewal and expansion revenue targets. On the most complex accounts, this includes managing risk and opportunity independently across multiple internal client stakeholders and organizational layers, rather than a single point of contact.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes through the successful adoption and ongoing value realization of AvePoint solutions.

As a trusted advisor, you will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business goals, technology environment, and priorities, then translate those needs into actionable success plans. You will partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Technical Support, Services, and other internal teams to drive adoption, identify and mitigate risk, strengthen customer relationships, and position customers for long-term success.

This role is ideal for someone who is customer-obsessed, commercially aware, data-driven, and comfortable navigating both business and technical conversations with stakeholders ranging from administrators to executive leaders.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the customer success strategy for an assigned portfolio of customers, developing success plans tied to measurable business objectives, adoption milestones, and customer outcomes.
* Drive product adoption and value realization by helping customers understand, implement, and expand their use of AvePoint solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical teams, business leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Monitor customer health and engagement, using product adoption, customer sentiment, support history, engagement, and other customer data to identify opportunities and risks.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risk, creating clear action plans for customers showing signs of low adoption, disengagement, or dissatisfaction.
* Conduct Executive Business Reviews and strategic customer conversations that demonstrate realized value, measure progress against customer goals, and establish priorities for the next phase of the relationship.
* Partner with Sales on renewal readiness, ensuring customer value is clearly understood, risks are identified early, and key stakeholders are engaged well ahead of renewal.
* Identify growth and expansion opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and surfacing qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales teams.
* Maintain accurate customer records and success plans in AvePoint's customer systems, ensuring customer health, activity, risks, opportunities, and next steps are current and actionable.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources across Sales, Support, Services, Product, and other teams to remove customer barriers and drive successful outcomes.
* Develop expertise in AvePoint's platform and solutions, enabling credible conversations about how AvePoint can address customers' evolving governance, security, data management, and technology needs.
* Plan and conduct onsite customer engagements as appropriate to strengthen executive alignment and deepen understanding of customer priorities.

  

**OK, I'm interested… is this the job for me?**

We look for people who value agility, accountability, curiosity, passion, and teamwork. You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy building relationships, solving complex customer challenges, using data to guide decisions, and helping customers turn technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* 2+ years of experience in a technical consulting role such as technical account management or technical business analysis
* Strong customer satisfaction, customer service, adoption, and retention experience
* Excellent written/verbal communication, organization, presentation, and project management skills
* Ability to work individually and within a highly collaborative global team setting
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
* Strong experience in communicating with different stakeholders and decision makers, both internally and externally
* Expert at customer relationship management
* Advanced ability to understand business objectives through requirements gathering and analysis
* Impeccable organizational awareness skills

**Knowledge in the following technical areas are a plus:**

* Understanding of Microsoft SharePoint architecture, components, and configuration. Understand the differences between the SharePoint versions and Office 365 collaboration technologies
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, Active Directory, SMTP, and DHCP technologies
* Working technical knowledge of current software protocols and Internet standards
  

The Salary Range for this role is $83,000 - $125,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
**Real Estate Administrative & Transaction Coordinator**

**One Corner | Keller Williams ONEChicago**

**Location:** Chicago, IL | Flexible work arrangement  
**Compensation:** $25–$30 per hour, depending on experience  
**Schedule:** Approximately 20–25 hours per week, with potential for growth  
**Reports To:** Director of Business Operations & Growth

About One Corner

At One Corner, our focus is on people, not transactions.

Real estate is about so much more than buying, selling, or leasing property. We get to help people navigate different seasons of life—new beginnings, big changes, exciting milestones, and all the complicated stuff in between.

We're a close-knit team that genuinely enjoys the people we work with, from our clients to our colleagues. We believe in showing up for one another, communicating openly, doing good work, and finding reasons to laugh along the way.

We're growing, and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of what we're building.

**Position Overview**

We're seeking an experienced, highly organized Real Estate Administrative & Transaction Coordinator to handle the day-to-day administrative details and transaction coordination for our growing team.

This role is focused on keeping transactions, leasing activities, listings, communications, and administrative records organized, accurate, and moving forward.

You'll be an important part of making sure our agents can focus on their clients while the details behind the scenes are handled thoughtfully and consistently.

We're looking for someone with residential real estate experience who understands the moving pieces of a transaction, enjoys keeping things organized, and takes pride in seeing things through.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Transaction Coordination**

* Manage administrative coordination of buyer and seller transactions from contract through closing.
* Monitor deadlines, required documentation, contingencies, and outstanding items.
* Coordinate communications with agents, attorneys, lenders, title companies, and other transaction partners.
* Maintain accurate transaction files, checklists, and records.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding requirements and escalate potential issues.
* Ensure tasks are completed according to established procedures.

**2. Leasing Coordination**

* Manage the administrative coordination of landlord and tenant transactions through listing and lease execution.
* Track applications, lease documents, deadlines, and outstanding requirements.
* Coordinate with agents, clients, property managers, and other involved parties.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure timely follow-through.

**3. Listing Support & Coordination**

* Coordinate administrative preparation and launch of new listings.
* Prepare and maintain MLS entries, listing information, documentation, and updates.
* Coordinate photography, staging, vendors, and listing-related appointments according to established processes.
* Assist with open-house scheduling and logistics.
* Maintain listing checklists, files, and outstanding tasks.
* Participate in weekly team listing meetings.
* Support ongoing listing administration through contract execution.

**4. Administrative & Email Coordination**

* Manage designated email inboxes and assigned correspondence.
* Handle routine communications and delegated follow-ups, including those assigned by team leadership.
* Organize and prioritize requests, track outstanding items, and ensure timely responses.
* Maintain established administrative workflows, checklists, and tracking systems.
* Identify incomplete tasks, potential delays, or issues requiring escalation.
* Communicate progress and exceptions to the Director of Business Operations & Growth.
* Provide additional administrative and coordination support as needed, helping the team navigate shifting priorities and day-to-day business needs.

**5. Commission Processing & Accounting Administration**

* Prepare and submit commission documentation for completed transactions.
* Track commission submissions, payment status, and outstanding items.
* Maintain accurate transaction and commission records to support compliance.
* Update internal accounting documents to reflect closed transactions.
* Assist with reconciling transaction information and identifying discrepancies.
* Coordinate administrative follow-up regarding commission and payment documentation.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Previous residential real estate experience in transaction coordination, leasing coordination, operations, or administration.
* Strong understanding of residential real estate transactions and deadlines.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple administrative tasks and competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets.
* Ability to work within established procedures while proactively identifying outstanding items.
* Professionalism when communicating with clients, agents, and vendors.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with Chicago-area residential real estate contracts and transaction practices.
* Experience with MLS systems, DocuSign, and transaction management platforms.
* Experience with commission processing or administrative accounting.

**Who You'll Work Well With**

We appreciate people who care about their work, communicate honestly, and enjoy being part of a team.

We value curiosity, a willingness to learn, a sense of humor, and the ability to navigate challenges together.

We believe good working relationships are built on trust, mutual respect, and the understanding that we're all human.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Transactions and leasing files are organized, accurate, and progressing on schedule.
* Deadlines and outstanding requirements are proactively monitored and addressed.
* Listing launches are coordinated smoothly with minimal administrati

new_jobs.title: Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II - IHSS (Open)
new_jobs.description:
San Mateo County Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the **Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II – In-Home Supportive Services Public Authority (ESPI CPS II)** within Aging and Disability Services (ADS).

This position supports the ongoing improvement and modernization of the In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Public Authority (PA) by developing automated systems, dashboards, and digital tools that enhance program operations, service accessibility, and staff productivity. The role also assists with caregiver recruitment and onboarding, referral coordination, and the development of policies, procedures, and training materials, while ensuring that all initiatives incorporate racial equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.

**Important Note:** The IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist **is not a County classified position;** however, the role reports directly within ADS. The eligible list generated from this recruitment may be used to fill future extra-help, term, unclassified and regular classified vacancies.

This is a full-time position working Monday–Friday. A hybrid schedule may be available; however, approximately four on-site workdays per week are anticipated based on operational needs and County requirements. The position is currently located in San Mateo, CA, but will relocate to South San Francisco, CA, planned for March 2027. The role requires travel throughout the County and periodic travel within the State of California.

**About the IHSS Public Authority**

Established by the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in 1993, the IHSS Public Authority administers the care provider components of the County’s IHSS program.

IHSS supports Medi-Cal eligible individuals who are aged, blind or living with disabilities at any age so they can safely remain in their homes as an alternative to institutional care.

**The IHSS Public Authority:**

* Serves as the employer of record for approximately 10,000 IHSS care providers
* Operates a Registry that recruits, screens, and refers care providers to IHSS recipients
* Conducts background checks in accordance with IHSS regulations
* Provides training opportunities to enhance care provider skills
* Offers support to both recipients and care providers to promote successful working relationships
* Administers payroll, personnel services, health benefits, and COBRA
* Maintains employment records, conducts verifications, and responds to subpoenas
* The IHSS PA is advised by the Public Authority Advisory Committee (PAAC), appointed by the Board of Supervisors, with a majority of the members being current or former IHSS recipients and/or care providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**The** **IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist** **will:**

* Assist in development and maintenance of systems, automated tools, and improvement charters designed to boost IHSS PA operations utilizing both AAS’ Racial Equity Action Plan (REAP) and LEAP process improvement standards
* Implement Quality Assurance (QA) standards in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reporting systems that will be used in IHSS PA work processes, as well as monitor staff workload and productivity
* Assist in the development and maintenance of a self-service portal for referral submissions by external entities
* Assist in the development and maintenance of an online job board intended to help match IHSS recipients with care providers, implementing equity, diversity, and inclusion standards.
* Assist in the migration of paper-driven onboarding processes to digital processes, a process that will expedite accessibility of newly hired care providers to IHSS recipients
* Assist in recruiting and onboarding care providers, to help remediate the current care provider shortage, utilizing a racial equity lens
* Work with the IHSS PA Supervisors to devise, triage, and assign referrals to Payroll Specialists and Registry Social Workers
* Work closely with IHSS Community Program Analysts in the development and maintenance of automation-related projects designed to enhance the accessibility of Payroll and Registry services for IHSS recipients
* Update existing and create new IHSS PA policies and procedures to reflect current and new programmatic practices
* Update existing training materials and training IHSS PA staff, integrating a social and equity lens

The **ideal candidate** will be:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, well suited for large government or non-profit social service programs.
* Experience working with case management databases like the Case Management, Information and Payrolling Services (CMIPS II) and Microsoft Suite Applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel).
* Experience with process improvement best practices and LEAP process improvement principles and methodologies.
* Experience training community members and/or staff in programmatic updates and new operational requirements requiring updated work practices.
* Strong understanding of social and racial equity principles leading to the County of San Mateo’s Equity Framework.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Knowledge of:**

* Principles, practices, and administrative requirements of the program to which assigned.
* Contemporary social, political and economic trends and problems related to community services.
* Principles of social planning and program development related to community services.
* Specialized technical knowledge related to assigned program area.
* Monitoring and evaluating systems for community services programs.
* Current social and community needs.
* Principles and practices in community development and services planning.
* Methods applied to the collection and evaluation of statistical data.
* Principles of community organization.
* Applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations and County and program policies and guidelines.
* Computer applications related to the work.
* Office ad

new_jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Fellow**
----------------

We believe that the act of making should be meaningful and fulfilling, done with intention and precision. Fellow makes beautifully functional tools for any kitchen, designed in San Francisco and used around the world.

When the simple motions of life become small moments of joy, that’s Everyday Magic.

*This is a temporary, 3-month contract role working 40 hours per week. This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office and requires regular in-office presence in accordance with company policy.*

**Who You Are**
---------------

Fellow is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to help us find and engage exceptional talent as we grow. You’ll build candidate pipelines across priority openings and screen candidates, with a focus on roles in consumer packaged goods, hardware, and electronics.

You’re curious, resourceful, and energized by the hunt. You know how to move beyond the obvious search, understand what makes someone a strong fit, and write outreach that gets a response. You bring a thoughtful approach to candidate relationships and the organization to keep multiple searches moving in a fast-paced environment.

Reporting to the Director of People & Talent, you’ll partner closely with our recruiting team and hiring managers to understand hiring needs, develop sourcing strategies, and connect us with talented people who might not otherwise find Fellow.

This is a hands-on role with an opportunity to make an immediate impact. You’re comfortable jumping into new searches, asking good questions, and adjusting your approach as you learn.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build and maintain qualified candidate pipelines across priority openings, particularly in CPG, hardware and electronics.
* Partner with the recruiting team and hiring managers to understand role requirements, align on target profiles and refine searches based on feedback.
* Identify talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, sourcing platforms, referrals, industry research and other creative channels.
* Write personalized outreach that introduces Fellow and gives candidates a compelling reason to connect.
* Conduct initial candidate conversations to understand experience, interests, availability and alignment with the opportunity.
* Proactively seek talent from a broad range of backgrounds to build diverse candidate pipelines.
* Keep candidate records, outreach activity, and pipeline stages accurate and up to date in Ashby.
* Track outreach response, candidate engagement, and pipeline conversion to identify what’s working and adjust your approach.
* Share market insights and candidate feedback to help the team make informed hiring decisions.
* Use AI, automation and sourcing tools thoughtfully to improve research, outreach, and efficiency while maintaining a personal candidate experience.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of sourcing or recruiting experience, with a strong track record of identifying and engaging passive candidates.
* Experience sourcing for CPG, hardware, and electronics companies, including an understanding of relevant talent markets and technical skill sets.
* Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and other sourcing tools and research techniques.
* Strong outreach and communication skills, with the ability to tailor your message to different candidates and roles.
* Ability to assess candidate backgrounds against role requirements and clearly communicate why someone may be a fit.
* Excellent organization and attention to detail, including maintaining accurate candidate records and managing multiple searches.
* Comfortable working independently, moving quickly, and adapting to changing priorities.
* Resourceful and scrappy, with a willingness to try new approaches when a search gets challenging.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems; familiarity with Ashby is a plus.
* Based in the Bay Area and available for a 3-month, 40-hour-per-week engagement.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
-----------------------------

* Warm, sincere company culture where everyone’s contributions are truly valued.
* A creative, fast-moving environment where ideas turn into action.
* Be part of a fun, collaborative, effective team that performs meaningful work
* Literally more coffee than you can drink (also tea, and yummy snacks!)
* Generous discount on Fellow products

Final compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills, expertise, scope of previous work, demonstrated impact, and internal equity. As a result, not every candidate will be hired at the top of the range.

*Our highest goal at Fellow is creating a safe, inclusive, and rewarding environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and thrive. We are committed to building diverse teams and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.*

===================================================================================

At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our rental facility in **Newark, CA** and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($24,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
* New business development and Client acquisition/Account development. Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business with our comprehensive jobsite solutions.
* Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications. Conducts sales presentations to prospective and existing customers.
* Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience.
* Manages and supports job site activities and projects with remote and on site involvement.
* Assists with Equipment rental, sales, and service when needed by customers on-site.

### **Why EquipmentShare?**

Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

We're a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Commission guarantee period while building book of business

* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO + paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events and quarterly team activities
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

### **About You**

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement  
* Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

### **Skills & Qualifications**

* First and foremost, we're looking for someone who's tenacious and innovative and possesses superior outside sales experience and skills with a proven sales track record
* Must be able to lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance.
* Heavy Construction Equipment or Industry knowledge (rental or construction) with experience in B2B is sales preferred, but not required (if you're a born salesperson, we'll train you on what you need to know and how to win more business)
* You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* You have the technical aptitude to adapt to the fast pace of a growing company and stay continuously educated on the latest EquipmentShare products and services
* You're competitive, self-motivated and results driven, but thrive in a team-oriented environment
* Ability to manage strategic and national accounts

### **A Workplace For All**

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — *A Workplace For All* — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

new_jobs.description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**

**About the Job**

Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With continued growth and increasing adoption among enterprise customers, our solution is rapidly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**About Netradyne**

Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions, helping organizations improve driver safety, operational performance, and fleet visibility through AI-powered technology.

As our enterprise business continues to scale, we are evolving Customer Success into a more strategic, proactive, and commercially focused organization.

**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**

**Overview**

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager is a strategic customer-facing leader responsible for managing a focused portfolio of Netradyne's largest and most important enterprise customers.

This role combines customer strategy, operational execution, data-driven consulting, and commercial ownership to ensure customers maximize the value of Netradyne's AI-powered fleet safety platform.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager will own approximately 4–6 high-value enterprise customers representing $4M–$6M+ in ARR and lead the customer journey across implementation, adoption, value realization, retention, renewal, and expansion.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, helping customers define measurable business objectives, establish Customer Success Plans, accelerate deployment and adoption, and demonstrate tangible impact across safety, operations, and overall fleet performance.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager will also serve as the primary cross-functional leader for assigned accounts, partnering closely with Sales, Implementation, Product, Support, Field Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure customers view Netradyne as a strategic business partner rather than simply a technology provider.

The ideal candidate brings significant enterprise customer-facing experience, strong executive presence, commercial instincts, analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated record of driving adoption, retention, expansion, and measurable customer outcomes.

**Essential Functions**

**Executive Customer Leadership**

* Build trusted advisor relationships across multiple levels of each customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive decision-makers.
* Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Operations, Safety, IT, Finance, and other functional leadership teams.
* Understand each customer's business objectives, operational challenges, safety priorities, and ROI expectations.
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on measurable business outcomes and long-term value.
* Facilitate Executive Business Reviews focused on ROI, adoption, safety performance, operational improvements, and strategic priorities.
* Build multi-threaded relationships that strengthen customer retention and create long-term strategic partnerships.

**Strategic Enterprise Onboarding & Adoption**

------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid-remote US-based Account Management team. Your primary objective is to increase the value of Rippling’s Spend for your customers through growth, expansion and retention of the Rippling Spend SKUs (Expenses, Corp Cards, Bill Pay, and Travel). **About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a creative, organized, and proactive Social Media & Content Coordinator to support the company's growing content and social media efforts. This role reports to the Social Media, Influencer & Content Manager and is ideal for someone who enjoys both creating content and managing the day-to-day details that keep social channels active, responsive, and engaging.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with social media and content creation and is comfortable capturing photo and video content, performing basic video editing and graphic design, and supporting content production across a fast-paced marketing environment.

You'll work closely with and assist Fabuwood's Content Creator while collaborating with the broader marketing team to help increase the amount of content produced internally, strengthen community engagement, support influencer and partner activity, and contribute to larger productions and events. The goal is simple: consistently create useful, engaging content while helping Fabuwood stay active, responsive, and connected across social media.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM - 5:00PM, F 8:00AM - 12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Capture photo and video content on an ongoing basis for social media, internal marketing, product storytelling, events, and other brand initiatives.
* Photograph and film social-first content as needed, including product features, behind-the-scenes content, tutorials, employee or partner content, event coverage, and short-form video.
* Assist the Content Creator with day-to-day content production, including preparing for shoots, capturing supporting footage, organizing assets, and helping execute content concepts across social platforms.
* Edit short-form video and prepare content for social platforms, including basic trimming, captions, formatting, transitions, and platform-specific adjustments.
* Create simple graphic assets for social media using approved brand guidelines, helping supplement the workload of the graphic design team when appropriate.

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, mentions, and other community interactions in a timely and brand-appropriate manner.
* Escalate customer concerns, sensitive messages, or issues to the Director of Marketing or appropriate internal team when additional support is needed.
* Proactively engage with designers, dealers, influencers, partners, and other relevant accounts to help strengthen relationships and expand Fabuwood's social presence.
* Track influencer and content-partner deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and contractual requirements to help ensure commitments are completed on time.
* Maintain organized content files and support the social media content calendar by helping coordinate assets, posting needs, deadlines, and upcoming opportunities.
* Provide additional social media and content support as needed, including trend monitoring, content research, asset gathering, and day-to-day marketing requests.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, communications, or a related role; strong internship or portfolio experience may also be considered.
* Hands-on experience capturing high-quality photo and video content using a smartphone, camera, or similar content-production tools.
* Basic video-editing skills and comfort creating short-form content for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, or similar channels.
* Basic graphic-design capabilities using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design platforms.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, community engagement, and platform-specific best practices.
* Excellent written communication skills with the judgment to represent a brand professionally in comments, messages, and public interactions.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple content requests, deadlines, and deliverables at once.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and content needs may shift quickly.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and know when to escalate questions, customer issues, or brand-sensitive situations.
* Comfortable using approved company-issued devices and account-access procedures to manage social media channels securely.
* A collaborative, hands-on attitude and willingness to support content capture at events, productions, showrooms, and other locations as needed.

**Preferred Skills**

* Comfortable appearing on camera when appropriate, whether demonstrating a product, participating in a tutorial, showing hands in a how-to video, or being featured in brand content.
* Experience working with influencers, creators, designers, or brand partners and tracking campaign deliverables.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, analytics, or listening tools is a plus.
* Interest in interior design, kitchen and bath, home products, building products, architecture, or related industries is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood is producing more strong, timely content internally while maintaining an active and responsive social presence. Content is captured consistently, social communities receive thoughtful engagement, influencer commitments are tracked, and the marketing team has a dependable partner who can identify opportunities and help move content from idea to execution.

At Fabuwood, we value people who take ownership of their work, bring ideas forward, move quickly without sacrificing quality, and contribute to a collaborative, results-focused marketing team.

As a trusted advisor, you will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business goals, technology environment, and priorities, then translate those needs into actionable success plans. You will partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Technical Support, Services, and other internal teams to drive adoption, identify and mitigate risk, strengthen customer relationships, and position customers for long-term success.

* Own the customer success strategy for an assigned portfolio of customers, developing success plans tied to measurable business objectives, adoption milestones, and customer outcomes.

* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical teams, business leaders, and executive sponsors.

**About Us:**

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, **Divcon** delivers fully integrated automation solutions *nationwide* that optimize performance, energy efficiency, and reliability across HVAC, lighting, power monitoring, and mission-critical systems. Leveraging advanced technologies - including Allen-Bradley PLCs, Ignition SCADA, and Delta DDC systems - we combine deep technical expertise with field-tested execution to deliver precise, scalable, and high-performance solutions.

**About the role:**

TheAssistant Project Manager (APM) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of building automation and controls projects from installation through commissioning and turnover. This role is responsible for managing defined portions of projects and smaller-scale jobs while developing the skills required for full project ownership.

Working under the guidance of a Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager, the APM plays a key role in coordinating field activities, maintaining project documentation, and supporting budget and schedule tracking. This position is designed as a transitional step toward a full Project Manager role.

Please note our office address is 1702 4th Ave NW West Fargo, North Dakota 58078.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Execution Support**

* Assist in coordinating day-to-day execution of BAS/controls projects to ensure alignment with engineering designs, schedules, and customer requirements.
* Manage defined scopes of work or smaller projects under supervision.
* Support development and maintenance of project schedules, including milestone tracking and updates.

**Documentation & Project Controls**

* Obtain, organize, and maintain project documentation including contracts, drawings, and specifications.
* Assist in reviewing submittals and drawing packages prior to field execution.
* Maintain accurate project records in DivPro, including notes, milestones, and billing support data.

**Field & Subcontractor Coordination**

* Coordinate subcontractors and Controls Technicians for assigned project scopes.
* Support commissioning activities by tracking progress and ensuring task completion.
* Conduct site visits as needed to monitor progress and document field conditions.

**Financial & Administrative Support**

* Track purchase orders, change orders, and project expenses.
* Assist in monitoring project budgets and identifying potential variances.
* Support monthly billing processes and milestone reporting for review by the Project Manager.
* Assist with review of technician timecards for alignment with project work.

**Communication & Stakeholder Support**

* Participate in project meetings and provide updates on progress, risks, and issues.
* Support customer communication and help manage expectations on schedules and deliverables.
* Escalate project risks or issues to the Project Manager in a timely manner.

**Qualifications:**

* 2–3 years of experience in construction, project coordination, or related field (BAS, MEP, HVAC preferred).
* Experience supporting project execution, documentation, or field coordination.
* Exposure to project scheduling, subcontractor coordination, or construction processes preferred.
* Working knowledge of building automation systems, HVAC controls, or electrical systems preferred.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective communication skills with both internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software platforms.
* OSHA 30 certification obtained within the past two (2) years is required.
* + If certification is not current or has not been completed, OSHA 30 training will be provided and must be successfully completed within the first week of employment.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to travel frequently to job sites by car or plane, up to 95%
* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout job sites for extended periods
* Ability to climb ladders, stairs, and lifts as required
* Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, and work in tight or confined spaces
* Ability to lift, carry, and maneuver equipment and materials up to 50 pounds
* Manual dexterity to handle tools, wiring, and small components
* Ability to work at heights and in varying indoor and outdoor conditions
* Ability to wear and work in personal protective equipment when required (hard hat, vest, safety glasses, gloves, and safety-toed boots)
* Visual keenness to read schematics, labels, and digital displays
* Ability to visually identify and differentiate wires by assigned color
* Ability to hear and respond to alarms, equipment sounds, and verbal instructions
* Capability to safely operate hand and power tools

**Benefits & Total Rewards:**

* **Opportunities for Growth**

Hands-on training and career advancement in an exploding data-center industry.

* **Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance**

We cover 100% of individual medical premiums and help offset the cost of family coverage.

* **401K with Employer Match**

Eligible after 90 days, with company matching to help you invest in your future.

* **Disability Coverage**

Both short- and long-term disability insurance provided at no cost to our employees.

* **Flexible PTO**

Take time off when you need it, no accruing time necessary.

* **Field-Based Employee Benefits**

For eligible field-based roles that require travel, Divcon covers all business travel expenses and provides a per diem, phone allowance, tools, and PPE at no cost. Eligible employees also receive paid training and additional reimbursable business expenses.

Divcon does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Agencies must have a signed agreement in place prior to submitting any candidate. Unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Divcon, and no fees will be paid.
